name: City Council Meeting - Oct 14, 2025
agenda_text:
City Council Meeting
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
OCTOBER 14, 2025
REGULAR MEETING
5:00 P.M. - CLOSED SESSION
in council chamber AT 3031 Torrance Bl.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
FLAG SALUTE/NON-SECTARIAN INVOCATION
Flag Salute - Councilmember Kaji
Invocation - Councilmember Kalani
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comments on items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment, but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts to be distributed while you speak.
4.
CLOSED SESSION
